Sheet.EditPortraitHint: Click to crop/resize a portrait. Shift-click to pick a file directly.
Sheet.NoGear: No gear yet. Click "Add Gear" to create one.
Sheet.UseGear: Use (Shift-click to skip the Edge/Trouble prompt)
Sheet.NoPowers: No powers yet. Click "Add Power" to create one.
Sheet.NoTraits: No traits yet. Click "Add Trait" to create one.
Sheet.UsePower: Use (Shift-click to skip the Edge/Trouble prompt)
Sheet.StandingEdge: Has a standing Edge on Initiative
Sheet.MovementHint: Run/Climb/Jump/Swim are automatic (Climb/Jump/Swim default to half Run Speed). Glide/Swingline/Fly/Teleport only appear once a power grants them (set on the actor's movement fields).
Sheet.StandardActionsHint: Dodge/Help/Grab/Escape and Team Maneuvers per the book (p.29-31, p.38-39). Grab/Escape/Help use your current target(s) via normal Foundry targeting.
Sheet.RollAbilityHint: Roll (Shift-click to roll without the difficulty/Edge prompt)
Sheet.SplitDamage: Split damage between targets (off for grenades)
Sheet.CloseRangeTrouble: Trouble against targets this many spaces away or closer (Rifle, SMG: 5)
Sheet.OwnMultiplier: Weapon uses its own damage multiplier (grenades: 2; 0 = attacker's)
Sheet.LethalityAuto: Book default (weapons lethal, otherwise nonlethal; Heroic attackers hold back)

ImageCropper.Title: Crop Portrait
ImageCropper.PickHint: Choose an image to crop into a portrait.
ImageCropper.DragHint: Drag to reposition, scroll or use the slider to zoom. The crop always fills the frame.
ImageCropper.NoPermission: You don't have permission to change this character's portrait.
ImageCropper.UploadError: Couldn't save the cropped portrait. If you're not the Gamemaster, ask them to enable "Players can Upload New Files" in World Settings → Manage Permissions, or use "Choose Existing Image" instead.

SheetTheme.Name: Sheet Theme
SheetTheme.Hint: Choose a light or dark look for your own character and item sheets. This is a per-player preference — it doesn't affect what anyone else sees.

Condition.KilledNotice: has been Killed (Health at or below -max Health) — removed from play per the book, at the GM's discretion.
Condition.EndOfTurnDamage: {name} takes {amount} Health from being {conditions} at the end of their turn.
Condition.BlockedStunned: {name} is Stunned and cannot take any actions.
Condition.BlockedUnconscious: {name} is Unconscious and cannot take any actions.
Condition.BlockedShattered: {name} is Shattered and cannot take any actions.
Condition.BlockedParalyzed: {name} is Paralyzed and cannot take actions that require a Melee or Agility check.
Condition.BleedingStoppedByHealing: {name} recovered Health, so the bleeding stops.

Karma.SpentForEdge: {name} spends 1 Karma to add Edge to their roll.
Karma.SpentForTrouble: {name} spends 1 Karma to impose Trouble on the attacker.
Karma.NoRecordedTarget: This roll didn't record a target to impose Trouble on.
Karma.RestRecovered: {name} rests for {hours} hour(s) and recovers {amount} Health and Focus.
Karma.ResetTitle: Reset Karma to standard (Rank, if Heroic)
Karma.NotYours: Only {name}'s owner can spend their Karma.

Action.DodgeNote: {name} is Dodging — attacks against them have Trouble until their next turn.
Action.DodgeClearedNote: {name}'s turn begins — their Dodge wears off.
Action.HelpNeedsTarget: Target the ally you want to Help first.
Action.HelpNote: {name} Helps {target} — they get an Edge on their next action.
Action.ControlledLanding: Controlled landing (reduces multiplier by Jump Speed: {jump})
Action.FallingDamageNone: {name} falls, but the distance is too short to cause damage.
Action.FallingDamageResult: {name} takes falling damage: x{multiplier} multiplier, {damage} damage.

TNCalc.Title: TN Calculator
TNCalc.ResultNote: Target Number for a {adjective} Rank {rank} action check: {tn}.

TeamManeuver.LevelCap: This team's average Rank allows up to Level {level}. Each member pays 5 Focus per level (or 1 Karma if short), so a lower level costs less.
TeamManeuver.NeedsTargets: Set a Team / Affiliation on your sheet (the same one your teammates use), or target your teammates, before starting a Team Maneuver.
TeamManeuver.PaidWithKarma: {name} covers their share with 1 Karma instead of Focus.
TeamManeuver.Revived: {name} is brought back by the team's Rally: Health and Focus are now at least 0.
TeamManeuver.ChooseMembers: Who is taking part? Everyone sharing your Team / Affiliation is listed; those in the current combat start checked.
TeamManeuver.NeedsTwo: Pick at least one teammate besides yourself.
TeamManeuver.NobodyPaid: Nobody could pay for the maneuver (not enough Focus or Karma), so nothing happened.
TeamManeuver.RallyPrompt: Rally: each member may make one free recovery roll, for Health or Focus.
TeamManeuver.RallyNotYours: Only {name}'s owner can choose their Rally recovery.
TeamManeuver.RallyAlreadyUsed: {name} has already made their Rally recovery.
TeamManeuver.RerollNote: Offensive Team Maneuver: rolled twice, kept {kept} over {other}.

Roll.NoActiveCombat: There is no active combat encounter — start one in the Combat Tracker first.
Roll.CannotJoinCombat: Couldn't add this character to the combat encounter — ask your GM to add them, then roll Initiative again.
Roll.KnockbackAvailable: Knockback available instead of the power's own Fantastic effect: {distance} spaces straight back (choose one).
Roll.SpendFocusHint: Extra Focus to spend beyond the base cost, in multiples of the scaling ratio. The whole spend can't exceed 5 x Rank or leave you below 1 Focus.
Roll.InsufficientFocus: Not enough Focus: using this would leave you below 1 Focus, which the book does not allow (p.81).
Roll.EdgeAppliedNote: Edge added: rolled an extra d6 ({die}) — new total: {total}.
Roll.TroubleAppliedNote: Trouble added: rolled an extra d6 ({die}) — new total: {total}.
Roll.EdgeTroubleAlreadyApplied: Edge or Trouble has already been added to this roll.
Roll.EdgeTroubleNoPermission: Only the person who made this roll, or the GM, can add Edge or Trouble to it.
Roll.FocusOverLimit: Can't spend {cost} Focus at once: the limit is 5 x Rank ({max} at Rank {rank}).

Damage.ApplyHint: Apply to your targeted tokens (or selected tokens, if none are targeted), using each one's own Damage Reduction.
Damage.UndoHint: Reverse all damage applied from this card.
Damage.NoTargets: Target or select the token(s) to apply damage to first.
Damage.NoPermissionCard: Only the person who made this roll, or the GM, can apply or undo its damage.
Damage.NoPermissionActor: You don't have permission to change {name}; ask the GM to apply it.
Damage.NothingToUndo: No damage from this roll has been applied yet.
Damage.NotAppliedHint: Not applied automatically: you can't edit that target. The GM can use Apply Damage.
Damage.StaleHint: Some of this damage was applied to a token you can't edit, so it still reflects the old roll. The GM can Undo and Apply Damage again.
Damage.AdjustedNote: Applied damage updated for the new result: {lines}.
Damage.BadFormula: Couldn't roll the damage formula "{formula}"; check it on the item sheet.

Relay.NoGM: That changes a character you don't own, so it needs a GM connected. Nothing was changed.
Relay.Failed: The GM's client couldn't make that change ({error}).

Weapon.CloseRangeNote: Target is {spaces} space(s) away: Trouble within {limit} spaces.
Weapon.ScatterNote: Missed the Challenging TN {tn} to land on target: the grenade lands {spaces} space(s) away (the Narrator picks the direction).

Concentration.AtLimit: {name} is already concentrating on {rank} power(s), their limit at Rank {rank}. End one first.
Concentration.EndHint: Click to end concentration on this power
Concentration.SightReminder: {name} is blinded: concentration ends on any of these that need line of sight: {powers}.
Concentration.HearingReminder: {name} is deafened: concentration ends on any of these that need hearing: {powers}.

HelperCheck.NoHelper: None of your characters can make this check.
HelperCheck.OutOfCombatOnly: {name} can only be helped this way outside combat.

bleeding.Title: Stop {name}'s Bleeding
bleeding.Hint: An action and a Logic check against TN 10 stops the bleeding. Anyone can try, including {name}.

ablaze.Title: Put Out {name}'s Fire
ablaze.Hint: An action and an Agility check against TN 10 smothers the fire. Anyone can try, including {name}.

awaken.Title: Wake {name}
awaken.Hint: Outside combat, a helper within reach makes a Challenging Logic check; on a success {name}'s Health returns to 1.

rally.Title: Rally {name}
rally.Hint: Outside combat, a helper who can communicate with {name} makes a Challenging Ego check; on a success their Focus returns to 1.

Deploy.Enabled: Using this places a token its user controls (drone, turret, decoy...)
Deploy.Name: Deployed Name
Deploy.Hint: When used, it appears next to the user's token on the current scene, owned by the same players. One at a time: using it again brings it back at full Health. It's removed at 0 Health, or when recalled from the user's sheet.
Deploy.RecallHint: Click to recall it from the field
Deploy.NoToken: {name} needs a token on the current scene to deploy this.
